tasks.gr12-listening-speaking-t3: Topic: Debate, prepared speech, seminar discussion, oral exam preparation. Grade 12 FAL learners present sustained arguments in debates, use persuasive language techniques, respond fluently to literary and social issues, and prepare for the oral examination component. Ask learners to identify effective debate techniques, choose persuasive language features, evaluate argument structure, recognise appropriate seminar discussion behaviour, and select strategies for oral exam preparation.
tasks.gr12-reading-viewing-t3: Topic: Poetry, drama, short stories, trial-exam revision, contextual analysis. Grade 12 FAL learners interpret prescribed texts with examination-level precision, analyse poetic devices (imagery, rhythm, tone), answer contextual questions on drama extracts, and revise key literary concepts for trial examinations. Ask learners to identify poetic devices, analyse tone in poetry, interpret dialogue in drama, answer contextual questions using textual evidence, and distinguish between different literary genres.
tasks.gr12-writing-presenting-t3: Topic: Argumentative or discursive essay, formal article, portfolio evidence, exam practice. Grade 12 FAL learners refine argumentative writing with a clear stance, logical structure, and counter-argument acknowledgement. They also practise transactional writing under timed conditions. Ask learners to identify features of argumentative vs discursive essays, choose effective introductions and conclusions, structure body paragraphs logically, apply formal article format conventions, and recognise counter-argument techniques.
tasks.gr12-language-structures-t3: Topic: Exam editing, style shifts, vocabulary refinement, punctuation, sentence control. Grade 12 FAL learners polish language accuracy and stylistic control ahead of major assessments, practise identifying and correcting errors in complex passages, and extend their vocabulary through context and word-family study. Ask learners to identify grammatical errors in passages, correct punctuation in complex sentences, choose words that improve style, recognise register shifts, and select the most accurate sentence structure.
